intro: Digital concept: a face-to-face picture game with spoken clues and human judgement.

steps.title: Look at the picture
steps.caption: The clue giver would view the picture; the guesser sits on the opaque-back side.

steps.title: Give a clue
steps.caption: Describe the picture with words or gestures without revealing its name.

steps.title: Let players judge
steps.caption: Another player guesses; people decide the answer, without speech recognition or automatic judging.

steps.title: Mark and take turns
steps.caption: Use the proposed correct or skip buttons, then take turns with the next picture.

intro: Digital concept: headphones with proposed Bluetooth audio and three physical controls.

steps.title: Review fit and setup
steps.caption: An adult would review fit and audio setup; physical evaluation is still required.

steps.title: Connect an audio source
steps.caption: A proposed Bluetooth module would connect an audio source without a companion app.

steps.title: Play and pause deliberately
steps.caption: Three proposed controls would manage playback and the agreed volume policy.

steps.title: Take a break and store
steps.caption: Pause listening, then store; charging and shutdown details still need validation.

intro: Digital concept: a manually turned picture drum with proposed recorded audio.

steps.title: Turn to a picture
steps.caption: Turn the proposed side control to bring one of six original picture faces into the window.

steps.title: Let the position settle
steps.caption: The visible face would select its approved recording after the drum settles.

steps.title: Replay or choose a language
steps.caption: Proposed replay and language controls would use the agreed recordings.

steps.title: Take another turn
steps.caption: Turn manually to another picture; no drive motor or loose cards are proposed.

intro: Digital concept: two visible word-part cards paired with approved audio recordings.

steps.title: Place two original cards
steps.caption: Place a left and a right original card so both word parts remain visible.

steps.title: Check the pair
steps.caption: The proposed optical codes would identify both cards and look up an approved pair.

steps.title: Hear parts or the whole
steps.caption: The left, right and whole-word controls would replay the approved recordings.

steps.title: Change one part
steps.caption: Change one card; an unapproved pair would get a neutral prompt, not an invented pronunciation.

intro: Digital concept: a picture playboard with six proposed press areas and recorded language audio.

steps.title: Prepare a scene
steps.caption: An adult would place an original panel and select its matching theme.

steps.title: Press a picture area
steps.caption: Each of six proposed press areas would play a short recorded word or description.

steps.title: Choose a language
steps.caption: A dedicated control would switch between the agreed language recordings.

steps.title: Explore together
steps.caption: Revisit pictures and share turns; the concept would not judge pronunciation.

intro: Digital concept: passive self-listening with no batteries or AI.

steps.title: Review the positioning
steps.caption: The proposed guide stays outside the mouth and ear; fit still needs prototype evaluation.

steps.title: Read in a gentle voice
steps.caption: Read gently; the passive concept would guide your own voice without electronic amplification.

steps.title: Listen and adjust naturally
steps.caption: Listen to your own voice and adjust naturally; no recognition or scoring is proposed.

steps.title: Put away and clean
steps.caption: Put the guide away; cleaning and storage methods still need evaluation.

intro: Digital concept: three visible activity stages with proposed time and pause controls.

steps.title: Prepare three stages
steps.caption: An adult would define the three-stage activity sequence and its time intervals.

steps.title: Choose the current activity
steps.caption: A proposed physical stage button would identify the current activity.

steps.title: See and pause the interval
steps.caption: The screen would show time and state; a deliberate pause would interrupt the countdown.

steps.title: Move on together
steps.caption: Confirm the next stage together; the proposed sequence would not advance silently.

intro: Digital concept: a standalone visual timer with a dial-selected interval.

steps.title: Set an interval
steps.caption: Turn the proposed dial to select an interval without using a phone.

steps.title: Start the countdown
steps.caption: A deliberate press would start the interval shown on the display.

steps.title: Pause or continue
steps.caption: A separate pause action would preserve the remaining time before continuing.

steps.title: Finish and reset
steps.caption: Review the visible end state, then reset; an alert remains an optional design direction.

intro: Digital concept: a shared observation bench with proposed manual focus and image capture.

steps.title: Choose a dry sample
steps.caption: An adult would prepare a dry leaf or fabric and check the intended power source.

steps.title: Place and illuminate
steps.caption: Place the sample on the open platform; controlled reflected lighting is proposed.

steps.title: Focus together
steps.caption: Adjust the proposed manual focus while comparing surface detail on the shared screen.

steps.title: Save and discuss
steps.caption: A proposed capture flow and adult-managed wired export would support later discussion.

intro: Digital concept: a screen-free camera for capture now and adult-led review later.

steps.title: Choose an observation task
steps.caption: An adult would check power and storage and explain that photos are reviewed later.

steps.title: Frame a subject
steps.caption: Use the proposed fixed window for rough framing during a short photo activity.

steps.title: Press and wait
steps.caption: Press the proposed capture control and wait for the distinct saving-status feedback.

steps.title: Review together
steps.caption: An adult would export files by cable and choose pictures to discuss without a cloud account.

intro: Digital concept: a two-grip camera with proposed rear preview and adult-managed wired export.

steps.title: Agree a photo task
steps.caption: An adult would introduce an observation task and check storage and power.

steps.title: Hold and frame
steps.caption: Hold both grips and frame a subject on the proposed rear preview display.

steps.title: Capture and review
steps.caption: The large proposed shutter would take a photo, followed by a simple review flow.

steps.title: Share with an adult
steps.caption: An adult would manage wired export and choose pictures to discuss; no wireless sharing is proposed.

intro: Digital concept: a tabletop game for watching, listening and repeating short sequences.

steps.title: Choose a short round
steps.caption: Choose a short proposed round and watch the demonstration.

steps.title: Watch and listen
steps.caption: Watch and listen as the shape buttons present a sequence.

steps.title: Repeat the sequence
steps.caption: Wait for the input cue, then repeat the sequence with the shape buttons.

steps.title: Replay or share a turn
steps.caption: Replay, choose a shorter round or pass the turn to another player.

intro: Digital concept: original question cards, manually entered IDs and four picture-answer buttons.

steps.title: Choose an original card
steps.caption: An adult would choose an original question card for the proposed round.

steps.title: Confirm its card ID
steps.caption: Enter and confirm the original card's printed ID before answering.

steps.title: Choose a picture answer
steps.caption: Choose one of the card's four picture options and press its matching button.

steps.title: Discuss and change the card
steps.caption: Discuss the proposed feedback, try again or choose another original card.

intro: Digital concept: a manually judged sliding puzzle with proposed retained pieces and no batteries.

steps.title: Choose a challenge
steps.caption: Choose an original starting layout and identify the target area.

steps.title: Move the retained pieces
steps.caption: Move the pieces along the proposed tracks; retention still needs physical testing.

steps.title: Check the target
steps.caption: Compare the large piece with the target by eye; no automatic board judgement is proposed.

steps.title: Reset and try again
steps.caption: Reset with an adult's guidance and choose a new challenge.

intro: Digital concept: a printed search card, shared finding order and manually finished timed round.

steps.title: Place a search card
steps.caption: Insert an original printed search card into the proposed board.

steps.title: Agree a route and begin
steps.caption: Agree a finding order with your partner, then start the proposed timer.

steps.title: Find with a partner
steps.caption: Point to each target in order while your partner observes.

steps.title: Finish and compare
steps.caption: Finish the round manually, compare your route and swap cards.

intro: Digital concept: short listening rounds with tones or spoken cues and four shape-marked buttons.

steps.title: Choose a listening round
steps.caption: Choose a short proposed listening round with an adult.

steps.title: Listen to the cues
steps.caption: Listen to the short sequence of tones or spoken cues.

steps.title: Respond with the buttons
steps.caption: Respond with the four proposed shape-marked buttons.

steps.title: Replay or share a turn
steps.caption: Replay, pause or swap turns before another listening round.

intro: Digital concept: reviewed offline audio questions with three answer buttons and dedicated replay.

steps.title: Choose a theme
steps.caption: An adult or player would select one of the proposed question themes.

steps.title: Listen to a short question
steps.caption: Listen to a short question and three options from the proposed reviewed offline content pack.

steps.title: Choose an answer
steps.caption: Press one of three answer buttons; the proposed response would use a stored answer table.

steps.title: Hear and take turns
steps.caption: Hear the short explanation, replay if needed, then pass the turn.
